description: First blessed canonical release. Stable-named symlinks to the trusted dated source files. The def14a director metadata is PRESENT as inputs but NOT yet joined into the firm/person panels — that join is the deferred 2026-05-31_def14a release.
notes: Entries are SYMLINKS to immutable dated source files (no duplication; disk is tight). The targets must not be deleted or overwritten.
Formats kept as CSV per project decision; .dta panels included as-is (Stata artifacts).
Zero-imputation of AI sentiment is a REGRESSION-TIME transform, not baked here — these files keep true missingness (NaN).
Sherlock: place data/canonical/ on $SCRATCH (like outputs/) since posts_full_coverage + posts_scored_unique are GB-scale.

company_sentiment_annual.csv.role: primary input — firm-year sentiment (Python regressions read this)

posts_scored_unique.csv.role: post-level scored (one row per unique post); person-level aggregation source

posts_full_coverage.csv.role: expanded post x person x company, 100% LM-scored; person-attr + firm-year metric source

def14a_director_status.csv.role: INPUT, not yet joined — incumbent/nominee/mid-year status per (cik,year,full_name). No age column in this run.

def14a_director_tenure.csv.role: INPUT, not yet joined — director x firm x year tenure windows for attribution gating

revelio_validation_summary.csv.role: input — Revelio strong_match flags per (profile, board)

funda_annual.csv.role: input — Compustat fundamentals (tobins_q, roa, sales_growth, ln_at, leverage, rnd_int, etc.)

firm_panel_annual.dta.role: built panel — firm x year, regression-ready (sentiment + funda + CRSP t/t+1)
